title: MongoDB Document Mapping
summary: Map a Java class and its identifier to a MongoDB document.

richText: Spring Data converts Java objects into MongoDB documents and documents back into Java objects.
@Document chooses the collection. @Id maps a Java field to MongoDB _id.
Use org.springframework.data.annotation.Id for MongoDB. jakarta.persistence.Id belongs to JPA.
@Field can choose a stored field name. Without it, the Java property name is normally used.
Mapping does not validate an HTTP request. Apply request validation separately.

example.title: Map a journal entry
description: Use a project configured with the MongoDB starter and connection URI.
Place JournalEntry.java under the application package.
explanation: ObjectId is the Java type of this document ID.
A new entry starts with a null ID. Spring Data can populate an ObjectId when inserting it.
The no-argument constructor allows Spring Data to create an object when reading the document.

richText: Use the same ID type in the mapped class and its repository.
An ObjectId string must contain a valid 24-character hexadecimal ID before it can be converted to ObjectId.
A malformed ID and a valid ID with no matching document are different cases. Handle them separately at the request boundary.
